svg.title: Project 2 of 2: Pricing-Engine. A new price for every product of Lumo, the shop from Data-Generator, from elasticity estimated on price history and discounts, five competitors' prices and margin rules. Each price has a one-sentence reason, and the true elasticity checks the result. Methods: price elasticity, empirical Bayes, price index, margin rules, profit scenarios. Stack: Python, pandas, DuckDB, SciPy, Streamlit. Animated preview: its web app (Streamlit) scrolls from the pricing rules and yearly profit to the proposals with their reasons. Link below the card: View project.
